'''Drouk''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of bipedal predatory creatures. They were powerfully built with armored carapaces and large arms. Some Drouks were capable of growing to immense size.<ref name="TOR" />

Drouks could be trained to fight in combat and take commands. Several were used in battle by the [[Warstalkers/Legends|Warstalkers]] on [[Denova]].

They were also kept as pets.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Drouks appear as enemies during the Operation: Explosive Conflict mission of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', and as bosses. Several varieties were also introduced as vanity pets. Their status as sentient or non-sentient is unclear.
